# sales-copy — listings, live scripts and win-back messages for Thai sellers

> **One rule:** every claim, price and offer in the copy must be true today and approved by the owner; a banned claim or an invented discount is removed, not softened.

## Pick the part

| Job (what the user says) | Open |
|---|---|
| Writing or fixing a marketplace product listing | [references/product-listing.md](references/product-listing.md) |
| Preparing a live selling session, run sheet or host lines | [references/live-selling-script.md](references/live-selling-script.md) |
| A shop wants lapsed regular customers back | [references/win-back-customers.md](references/win-back-customers.md) |

Shared files: [references/prohibited-claims.md](references/prohibited-claims.md) (claims check for food, supplement and cosmetic items), [references/description-template.md](references/description-template.md), [references/host-lines.md](references/host-lines.md).

## Steps every part shares

1. Collect the real facts first: product, price, stock, and any licence number (อย. or เลขจดแจ้ง) for food and cosmetics. Missing facts are written `(รอยืนยัน)`, never guessed.
2. Set the price after `pricing-and-costs` and the stock after `shop-operations`, so the copy matches the numbers in the system.
3. Run the claims check in [references/prohibited-claims.md](references/prohibited-claims.md) before the copy leaves your hands.

## Check before done

- No banned claim (treat, cure, "ของแท้ 100%" without proof, "อันดับ 1", "ถูกที่สุด") and no fake countdown or stock count.
- Every price and quantity said or written matches the platform's setting.
- Win-back: contact only the shop's own list, only people with a recorded marketing consent, at most 15 per round, and nothing sent before the owner approves each message.
- Live: show only a buyer's first name or username on screen, never a full name, phone or address.
- Marketplace buyers are never messaged outside the platform.

Whole job with several steps → playbook [new-product](../superuser/references/playbook-new-product.md) or [live-session](../superuser/references/playbook-live-session.md).
